top_choice_rationale: P001 (Mircea Cărtărescu alone) is the only proposal that names a writer, and it best meets my standard of a voice found in this writer's work and nowhere else, joined to the Nobel will's requirement. On public knowledge of Blinding (Orbitor) and Solenoid and the shortlist description, the voice is distinctive and the formal ambition is carried across very large structures. Memory, the body and dream form a coherent imaginative and intellectual project, with poetry as the root of the prose. The case rests on literary criteria and not on nationality, reputation, political symbolism or colleague agreement. Open reservations remain: how much Romanian rhythm and syntax survives translation, whether the late novels deepen the project or partly repeat it, and thin translation coverage of the poetry and early prose. None of these amounts to a failed criterion, so I rank P001 above no award. The citation should rest on the prose and name poetry only as its root. This is a modeled committee recommendation. It rests on public knowledge and the supplied descriptions, with no independent verification, and the full Swedish Academy makes any actual decision.
